content_html:
That was a great presentation. I really appreciate you coming to visit us when I was in Shreveport (and signing my book). It’s weird to hear my voice in that recording.
I’m still trying to completely wrap my head around your Onion Architecture in a concrete way. I understand it in theory, but then when I started looking at CodeCampServer, it’s a bit much to take in all at once when you’re used to looking at an n-tier design.
I may be tossing some questions your way in the near future regarding the topic.
Thanks again for these screencasts!
